summary.motive: Punish the defensive flow created by the base stretch by pulling the QB against the grain into a three-level boundary flood.
summary.keyDefender: Backside contain EDGE and flow-away flat defender (WILL)
summary.whyItWorks: The EDGE is reached inside on a block he must fight through while WILL takes genuine steps toward the stretch flow; by the time either reads boot, the QB is set at depth with all three levels already stretching the boundary.
summary.failureMode: A long-armed contain EDGE who keeps outside leverage through the reach and a flat defender who reads guard pulls rather than backfield flow will collapse the rollout before the third level clears.

beats.title: Same Stretch Picture
beats.text: For the first full second this is indistinguishable from the base call — every lineman reaches, the mesh point is real, and both edges commit to stopping the stretch.

beats.title: The Pull — Boot Away From Flow
beats.text: The QB pivots against the grain while the entire defense flows right; WILL has already taken three steps playside and the backside EDGE is fighting an inside reach he cannot win.

beats.title: Three Levels to the Boundary
beats.text: X pushes the carrying LCB past 14 yards before breaking the comeback, H drags behind the redirected MIKE, and the RB swings to the vacated flat — a full three-level stretch of a defense flowing the wrong way.

beats.title: Flat Defender Arrives Late
beats.text: The throw comes off the boot rhythm before WILL can close on the flat — the comeback or the back are both live because the run action bought the launch point for free.

relations.tell: The QB's ride turns into a reverse pivot against the flow — linemen keep blocking stretch right while the ball-carrier disappears left.
